I saw Vol. 1 DVD at Wal-Mart two years ago. I picked it up and saw "From the creators of Red vs. Blue". I went all O_O and is this an anime-ist show or a parody? Also it was only $9...it wasn't a parody :p
How did you guys became a fan of the show?
It's a long story of depression and trying to relearn myself...The short version is that. I came for the new adventure and stayed for the Yang.

I was on Roosterteeths site regularly to watch red vs blue saw rwby in the categories watched the red trailer and liked it so much I never stopped watching. Those months waiting for new trailers were painfully slow.

I actually avoided it for a while, as I'm not really into "anime." But I'm such a big fan of Rooster Teeth, I couldn't help hearing about it. One night I was bored and decided to watch a few episodes, and it became my guilty pleasure.

I was sort of a "closet fan" of Volume 1, but Volume 2 was so good that I can actually talk about the show with friends now.

I followed someone on DeviantArt for their Pokemon Nuzlocke. They submitted this pretty picture and someone commented "Is that from RWBY?" Since I had no idea what it was, I looked it up and went to Wikipedia. Read about the characters, found that trailers and binged season 1. Then it was a long wait for season 2 and I found myself hooked on everything about RWBY in the wait.

Followed RoosterTeeth and I saw the Red Trailer after Season 10 ended. I got hooked after seeing it.

I did hope that the story would be darker as the trailer suggested though.

The trailers being let out got me to immediately jump on the boat. The red and white trailer was the final selling point to me and I rewatched them so many times before the episodes came out. I love the idea of the dual type weapons and the music was so good from the start. The plot disappointed a bit but the action scenes made me come back every time.

Like most things in life that involved self-discovery, I just stumbled into it, and don't remember what happened.

Came for the weapons, stayed for the cute girls.
